name: c-cmake
title: CMake
summary: `find_package(llvm-dsdl)` provides `dsdlc_generate()`, which queries dsdlc for the exact input and output lists at configure time and produces a static library to link. Four lines of build file, and adding a definition needs no edit to any of them.
notes: Requires llvm-dsdl to have been installed, not merely built -- the package config and the function ship in the `bin` install component. Editing a definition regenerates; adding or removing one re-runs configure first. Removing a definition also deletes its generated header.

requires.reason: compiles the generated C and the round-trip program
